title: manihot gracilis subsp. varians
intro: Manihot gracilis subsp. varians, commonly known as the 'Pili' tree, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It is a type of plant that offers several health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, regulate blood sugar, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Manihot gracilis subsp. varians include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-diabetic agent. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
